data.description: 【杏山和纱 · 海边甜点与泳装】阳光灿烂的夏日沙滩上，和纱换上了别致的黑色比基尼泳装与可爱的猫耳遮阳帽，手里举着双球薄荷巧克力冰淇淋。黑发在海风中轻扬，粉瞳在粼粼波光下闪闪发亮——「这可是好不容易排队买到的限定冰淇淋！老师要是想吃的话……就乖乖陪我坐在遮阳伞下吃完再走。」
data.promptProse: Kazusa holds a double scoop of mint-chocolate ice cream on the sunny beach, wearing her black swimsuit and cat-ear swim hood with its small red ribbon. She looks toward the teacher with pleased pink eyes. The eye-level medium view leaves a parasol nearby and sparkling water behind. Summer sun illuminates the melting scoop edges and her raised hand, while the hood casts a gentle shadow around her forehead.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 夏日海滩·猫耳泳装与冰淇淋
